title: Rift Cataclysm
next_chapter_hook: Chen Tianming stretched out his hand from the rift, handing Chen Ji a blood-stained page—the fragment of the fourth page of the Tianji Record. The characters on that page twisted like living creatures, seemingly whispering to him a secret sealed for ten thousand years.

text.content:
Western outskirts of the imperial capital, night as dark as ink.

Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back atop the city wall, his robes billowing violently in the biting north wind. Seemingly calm while gazing at the distant horizon, his consciousness was actually immersed in the Tianji Record fragment, calculating every variation within the next three hours.

Just moments ago, he had witnessed the sickly Crown Prince—Zhao Heng's lips curl into an almost imperceptible arc. In that instant, Chen Ji distinctly caught a fleeting golden light glinting in the depths of the prince's eyes.

Vertical pupils.

A symbol of the Heavenly Celestial Eye.

Chen Ji's heart tightened, yet he did not panic. He had long grown accustomed to being observed by that invisible gaze. From the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, he understood he was merely a self-righteous piece in this grand chess game.

But what of it?

A chess piece could also turn against its manipulator.

Just as he was about to withdraw his consciousness, suddenly—a violent tremor erupted from the ground.

The tremor came without warning, yet so violent it chilled the heart.

The city bricks beneath Chen Ji's feet cracked like a spider's web, fine dust raining down. From the distant imperial capital direction, faint cries of alarm and sounds of chaos drifted over.

"What's happening?" His brow furrowed, his consciousness instantly extending outward.

The next instant, his pupils contracted sharply.

Northwest of the imperial capital, a pitch-black rift tore open the night sky. The rift was about three zhang wide, its edges continuously expanding and distorting, spewing forth demonic energy as thick as ink. Violet-black lightning ravaged around the rift, dyeing half the sky in an eerie hue.

Spatial-temporal rift.

The seal is loosening.

Chen Ji instantly understood what had happened—the temporary seal he had set up months ago had finally reached its limit.

dialogue.content: [Murmuring to himself] Come early or late, but exactly at this moment... These demonic path remnants, did they calculate the timing of the imperial capital competition perfectly?

text.content:
Chen Ji's figure flashed, rushing to the edge of the rift. The demonic energy struck him like a physical force, carrying the stench of decay and death. He waved his sleeve, true essence forming a barrier that kept that nauseating aura at bay.

Inside the rift was absolute darkness, fathomless, like a slumbering beast opening its blood-soaked maw.

But just as Chen Ji prepared to investigate—

"Chen Ji."

A hoarse yet familiar voice drifted from the depths of the rift.

That voice seemed to have traversed endless years, carrying vicissitudes and exhaustion, yet still emanating an inescapable authority.

Chen Ji's body froze.

This voice...

It was his father's.

It was Chen Tianming's voice.

dialogue.content:
[Pressing down the surging emotions, he said coldly] Father? How are you here? Weren't you—

[Before he could finish, a blinding light suddenly blazed from the rift's depths]

text.content:
That light was not ordinary spiritual radiance, but a strange dark gold. Within that glow, a blurred figure slowly emerged.

That figure was entwined with chains, surrounded by heavenly secret power entirely different from the demonic energy. His face was aged and haggard, temples frost-white, but those eyes remained sharp as blades.

It was Chen Tianming.

Only his condition was clearly dire—multiple wounds on his body still trickling golden blood, eyes tightly shut, as if enduring immense agony.

"The Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets... neither friend nor foe." Chen Tianming's voice came in fragments, each word seeming to cost him all his strength, "Chen Ji... you must... make a choice..."

Before he could finish, his body convulsed violently, the chains tightening, dragging him toward the deeper darkness.

"Father!"

Chen Ji reached out instinctively to grab him, but only clutched at emptiness. The violet-black lightning at the rift's edge suddenly surged, forcing him back several steps.

At that moment, his Tianji Record fragment shuddered violently.

An unprecedented sense of crisis flooded his heart.

Chen Ji abruptly looked up, gazing into the depths of the rift—

In that deepest darkness, an eye was slowly opening.

That eye was entirely different from the Heavenly Celestial Eye. It was pure black, profound as an abyss, as if it would devour all light in the world. Within its pupil, countless runes flowed—that was a power more ancient and terrifying than the Tianji Record.

Meanwhile, Chen Ji sensed another gaze descending from the nine heavens.

The Heavenly Celestial Eye.

Two transcendent gazes faced each other across the spatial-temporal rift, an invisible pressure instantly enveloping the entire imperial capital.

dialogue.content:
[His pupils slightly narrowed, his mind racing] Two forces surpassing the Heavenly Dao appearing simultaneously... This is definitely no coincidence. Someone is playing a very large game.

[A cold smile] However, if you want to use me as a chess piece, you'll have to see if you're willing to flip the chessboard first.

text.content:
Within the imperial capital, bells and drums rang in unison.

"Enemy attack—! The Xuanwu Sect army has broken through the outer defense line!"

The urgent horn blasts pierced the night sky, and chaos erupted on the city walls. Firelight lit up the heavens, countless cultivators soaring into the air, the city-protecting great formation humming and groaning, yet the Xuanwu Sect's battle formation ripped open a gap by sheer force.

Chen Ji's gaze turned cold, his consciousness instantly extending outward.

In the eastern gate direction of the imperial capital, the Xuanwu Sect's banners blotted out the sky. The leader wore玄black battle armor, held a mountain-splitting halberd, his aura as profound as the abyss—the very Han Lie.

"Tianqing Sect remnants, today is your day of death!" Han Lie's roar thundered like a violent explosion, "The struggle for the throne, Xuanwu Sect will see it through to the end! Whoever dares block our path shall be trampled underfoot!"

Behind him, thousands of Xuanwu Sect disciples formed a battle formation, their spiritual light connecting into one mass, killing intent surging to the heavens.

Chen Ji stood atop the city wall, gazing at that black mass of army, yet the corner of his mouth curved into a mocking arc.

Xuanwu Sect.

How perfectly timed.

The spatial-temporal rift erupts, and Xuanwu Sect immediately attacks—how could such a coincidence exist in this world?

The only explanation was that someone had calculated this move long ago, timing the rift's eruption with Xuanwu Sect's attack to the exact moment.

Those capable of such precision possessed either a divination method rivaling the Tianji Record, or—

Chen Ji's eyes narrowed as he gazed into the rift at that slowly opening black eye.

Or the master of that eye was themselves one of the chess players in this game.

"That fool Han Lie is probably still counting money for the one who sold him." He murmured to himself, "But... this is indeed a rare opportunity."

choice.prompt: The spatial-temporal rift and the sect war erupt simultaneously—Chen Ji must make a decision.

choices.description: Prioritize sealing the spatial-temporal rift, preventing the spread of demonic energy. Chen Tianming and an unknown terrifying existence lie behind the rift and cannot be ignored.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of true essence, possibly unable to timely support the imperial capital's defense.
choices.visible_reward: An opportunity to rescue Chen Tianming and obtain secrets from the rift's depths.
choices.risk_hint: If the imperial capital falls, Tianqing Sect will face annihilation; Han Lie may rise趁机.
choices.process_label: turn to rift, reinforce the seal

dialogue.content:
[His body moving, he dashes toward the rift] The imperial capital has plenty of defenders, but this rift... only I can handle it.

[His hands forming seals, heavenly secret power surges] Seal!

text.content:
Chen Ji landed at the rift's edge, his Tianji Record fragment flying from his sleeve, transforming into brilliant golden light that covered the rift. The demonic energy collided with heavenly secret power, producing an ear-piercing screech.

Sweat beaded on his brow, his Heavenly Fate Value draining like flowing water.

But the rift's expansion speed finally slowed.

Meanwhile, he faintly heard a sigh drift from the rift's depths—Chen Tianming's voice: "Well done... but not enough... the fourth page... you must find..."

choices.description: The Xuanwu Sect's threat is more urgent; if the imperial capital falls, everything else becomes meaningless. Defeat Han Lie first, then deal with the rift.
choices.visible_cost: The rift may further lose control, Chen Tianming's message will be interrupted.
choices.visible_reward: Publicly defeat Han Lie, greatly increase reputation, make Xuanwu Sect lose face completely.
choices.risk_hint: The terrifying existence in the rift's depths may take the opportunity to break free, with unimaginable consequences.
choices.process_label: face Han Lie with killing intent

dialogue.content:
[Turning to face Han Lie, a mocking smile playing at the corner of his lips] Han Lie, you've arrived at quite the opportune moment. What, here to take advantage while heaven collapses?

[Hands clasped behind his back, aura rising sharply] With that brain of yours, dare you call yourself a genius? You don't even realize you're being used as a pawn.

text.content:
Han Lie flew into a rage at these words, Spiritual Light blazing across his obsidian battle armor as he thrust his Mountain-Splitting Halberd directly at Chen Ji: "Waste! Still barking here! Today I'll make you understand what true disparity in strength means!"

His form erupted forward like a frenzied Black Tortoise beast, carrying the momentum to crush everything as he charged toward Chen Ji.

Chen Ji stood motionless, yet a cold glint flickered in his eyes.

Han Lie, Han Lie, the angrier you get, the bigger your openings become.

This time, before all under heaven, he would trample this so-called 'genius' beneath his feet.

choices.description: Neither the rift nor the sect war could be abandoned. Chen Ji decided to take a dangerous gamble—attacking both sides simultaneously. This would drain more Heavenly Fate, but the rewards would be tremendous.
choices.visible_cost: Facing two major crises simultaneously, consuming immense energy and potentially exposing more trump cards
choices.visible_reward: If successful, he would leave an invincible impression in everyone's hearts, gaining both the secrets within the rift and the glory of repelling the Xuanwu Sect
choices.risk_hint: Once failed, he would be trapped in a two-front war, surrounded by enemies on all sides
choices.process_label: heavenly chronicle splits, one part to rift, one to Han Lie

dialogue.content:
[Left hand beckoning, the Tianji Record transformed into golden light and flew toward the rift] The rift is yours to handle.

[Right hand making a虚握 gesture, a pitch-black sword materialized in his palm] As for this stupid dog Han Lie...

[Stepping through the air, ascending toward that rushing obsidian figure] Let me send him to his end personally.

text.content:
Chen Ji's form carved a诡异的 arc across the night sky, dodging Han Lie's thunderous halberd strike. His sword swept horizontally, ink-like blade light aiming directly for the other's throat.

Han Lie's pupils constricted, hastily crossing his halberd to block.

Clang—!

In the clash of metal, Han Lie was actually forced back three steps, his tiger's grip faintly numb.

"This..." He widened his eyes, disbelief plastered across his face, "When did you, waste..."

Meanwhile, from the rift direction came a thunderous roar. The golden light of the Tianji Record collided violently with the Demonic Path aura, actually suppressing the rift's expansion momentum.

"Impossible!" Han Lie howled, "How can you possibly..."

dialogue.content:
[Sword momentum uninterrupted, one strike faster than the last] Nothing is impossible.

[A cold laugh] Han Lie, did you think all these years I played the waste in front of you was genuine?

[Blade light surging violently] You're merely the whetstone I used to sharpen my blade.

text.content:
Ink-like sword light spread across the sky.

Chen Ji's attacks were fierce yet precise, each strike aimed directly at Han Lie's vitals and openings. Though the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius possessed staggering Combat Power, he was left scrambling and disgraced beneath Chen Ji's blade.

"Despicable!" Han Lie roared repeatedly, his Mountain-Splitting Halberd dancing madly, yet never once touching Chen Ji's clothes, "You waste,只会 dodging? Face me head-on if you have the guts!"

Chen Ji heard this, his mocking expression deepening.

"Face-to-face combat?"

His form flickered, instantly appearing before Han Lie, sword tip pressed against the other's throat.

"Am I not currently fighting you?" His voice was cold as frost, "Han Lie, you can't even block three of my moves, yet dare call yourself a genius? You've humiliated the Xuanwu Sect's face."

Above the city walls, countless Tianqing Sect disciples watched in stunned disbelief.

That 'waste Senior Brother' they'd mocked for years was now trampling the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius beneath his feet, sword pointing at his throat, looking down upon all under heaven.

"Chen... Senior Brother Chen..."

"Good heavens, is this still that servant disciple?"

"So all these years, he was hiding his true abilities!"

Exclamations rose in waves, everyone's gaze toward Chen Ji completely transformed—from contempt to reverence, from mockery to shock.

And from the Xuanwu Sect's direction, thousands of disciples turned ashen. Their invincible Senior Brother in their hearts was now being suppressed like a stray dog.

The blow to their morale was devastating.

Han Lie's face flushed crimson, veins bulging, yet he couldn't move.

That pitch-black sword carried some bizarre power, firmly locking his meridians, preventing him from even mobilizing his true essence.

"Who... who are you?" He clenched his teeth, questioning through gritted teeth, eyes full of不甘 and fear, "You're not Chen Ji! You're absolutely not that waste!"

Chen Ji looked down at him, eyes utterly unruffled.

"I am who I am." His voice was indifferent as water, "As for why you're being suppressed by a 'waste'..."

[The sword pressed down slightly, slicing a bloody gash across Han Lie's neck]

"Perhaps... you're simply too weak?"

Just then—

A deafening roar echoed from the rift direction.

Chen Ji's brow furrowed as he猛地 turned to look.

The spatiotemporal rift he'd temporarily suppressed was now expanding violently once more. Purple-black lightning raged savagely, tearing half the sky into fragments.

And in that darkness' depths, that pitch-black eye had fully opened.

It was staring directly at Chen Ji.

That gaze held no hostility, no killing intent—only a hair-raising scrutiny—likening him to an ant, or to prey about to be harvested.

Meanwhile, a voice exploded in Chen Ji's consciousness:

"Interesting... the Tianji Record's bearer... let me see, how far can you go..."

dialogue.content:
[Heart shuddering, the Tianji Record Fragment trembling violently] What kind of existence is this? Actually able to directly invade my consciousness?

[Suppressing the discomfort, he said coldly] I don't care who you are—if you want to use me as a chess piece... ask this sword first.

text.content:
That pitch-black eye seemed to hear his words and actually let out a low laugh.

"Chess piece?"

The laughter overflowed with mockery and playfulness, "Do you think you have the right to choose? From the moment you obtained the Tianji Record... everything was already destined."

Before the words finished, a hand suddenly extended from the rift's depths.

That hand was pale as paper, withered as kindling, yet radiated a terrifying pressure. Resting in its palm was unmistakably a blood-stained page.

The script on that page writhed like a living thing, emanating an aura identical to the Tianji Record Fragment.

The fourth page.

A fragment of the Tianji Record's fourth page.

And that hand was reaching toward Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
[Pupils contracting violently, staring fixedly at that blood-stained page] That's... the fourth page? Impossible! How could the Tianji Record's secrets appear here?

[Divine sense probing frantically, trying to see the hand's owner] Father... no, that's not Father's aura... who are you?!

text.content:
In the rift's depths, that hand continued slowly extending.

Only then did Chen Ji clearly see that the wrist of that hand was wrapped in countless chains, their other ends disappearing into endless darkness.

And those chains' style were identical to those he'd just seen binding Chen Tianming.

"Chen Ji."

That aged yet authoritative voice rang out again, this time even clearer.

"I am Chen Tianming, but also not merely Chen Tianming."

"The Tianji Record has nine pages total. I was once the bearer of the second page. And you... are the only person in ten thousand years to bear both the first and third pages simultaneously."

"This fourth page... should have been yours."

The blood-stained page radiated a tempting glow, seemingly calling to Chen Ji.

Meanwhile, from the direction of the Eastern City Gate came earth-shaking war cries.

The Xuanwu Sect's assault was more fierce than anticipated. Despite the disadvantage of Han Lie's suppression, the Xuanwu Sect showed no sign of collapse—instead, like a provoked beast, they launched even more frantic attacks.

"Senior Brother! Hold on!"

"For the Xuanwu Sect's glory, kill!"

Chen Ji's gaze swept across, seeing multiple breaches already appearing on the city walls. Tianqing Sect disciples were fighting desperately, but casualties were mounting rapidly.

And from the rift direction, that pitch-black eye's gaze grew increasingly intense, seemingly urging him to make a choice.

Accepting the fourth page might grant power and knowledge beyond imagination, but it might also lead into an unknown trap.

And if he doesn't accept... who knows what other moves the eye's master has in store.

Torches blazed across the walls, screams echoing one after another.

choice.prompt: The blood-stained fourth page fragment of the Tianji Record was right before his eyes, while the Xuanwu Sect's assault grew increasingly fierce. Chen Ji had to make a choice between temptation and crisis.

choices.description: The temptation of the Tianji Record's fourth page was irresistible. This was a rare once-in-a-millennium opportunity—whatever scheming lay behind it, it was worth the risk.
choices.visible_cost: Might step into an unknown trap, and would expose more trump cards to the pitch-black eye's master
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Tianji Record's fourth page fragment, unlock stronger abilities, and potentially learn the Tianji Record's true secrets
choices.risk_hint: The eye's master's purpose remains unclear—accepting the fragment might play right into their hands

dialogue.content:
[Steps forward, extending hand] No matter who you are, or what you want... this page fragment, I'll take it.

[The moment fingertips touch the blood-stained page, a flood of information rushes into the mind] This is...!

text.content:
When Chen Ji's fingers touched the blood-stained page, a mighty torrent of information crashed into his Mental Sea.

It was—the content of the fourth page of the Tianji Record.

"The Tianji Record consists of nine pages. Only when all nine are united can the true form be seen. First page observes oneself, second page observes people, third page observes the trend, fourth page..."

His pupils constricted sharply.

"Fourth page, observe heaven."

Just as he was digesting this information, that dark eye's laughter rang out again:

"Excellent... you've accepted the fourth page... From now on, you are the most important piece in this chess game..."

"No—"

Chen Ji woke with a start, wanting to release his hand, yet discovered the page had already merged with his Mental Sea, impossible to separate.

dialogue.content:
[Expression slightly changes, yet forces composure] Observe heaven? What purpose does observing heaven serve?

[Cold laugh] Think a single fragment can buy me? You underestimate me. No matter who you are... My Chen Ji's fate has always been in my own hands.

choices.description: The master of that dark eye has unclear intentions. Accepting rashly might fall right into their trap. Better to abandon this fragment than satisfy an enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Missed the fourth page of the Tianji Record, and possibly offended the mysterious existence within the rift
choices.visible_reward: Maintain mystery, don't reveal trump cards, and make the enemy's plans fall through
choices.risk_hint: That existence might fly into a rage because of this, with unpredictable consequences
choices.process_label: step back, coldly watch the hand

dialogue.content:
[Steps back, voice cold] No merit, no reward. We've never met—why give me such a grand gift?

[Sword tip points at that hand] If you want me to accept, first tell me who you are and what you want.

text.content:
That dark eye fell silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful laugh.

"Interesting... the first person in ten thousand years to dare refuse the Tianji Record..."

"Very well... this seed, I've already planted."

The hand slowly withdrew, and the blood-stained page vanished into the darkness.

"Chen Ji, we shall meet again... when you are prepared to accept the truth..."

The rift began to slowly close, and that dark eye gradually faded into the depths of darkness.

But before vanishing, a flicker of... approval? clearly flashed within that eye.

dialogue.content:
[Staring at where the rift sealed, brow furrowed] What does this existence truly want?

[Cold hmph] Fine, whatever schemes you harbor... my Chen Ji will face them head-on.

[Turns to gaze toward the east city gate, killing intent chilling] Now... time to handle another matter.

choices.description: Neither directly accept nor directly refuse. First probe that existence's bottom line, then decide after gaining more leverage.
choices.visible_cost: Might provoke that existence, causing the rift to spiral out of control
choices.visible_reward: Might extract more intelligence, and preserve room for choice
choices.risk_hint: If negotiations collapse, might lose on both fronts
choices.process_label: stand unhurried, gaze at dark eyes unflinching

dialogue.content:
[Stands with hands behind back, gaze calm] For me to accept this fourth page, very well. But I need to know—

[Extends hand] First, who are you? Second, why are you imprisoned here? Third, what other costs exist that I don't know about this fourth page?

[Tone turns icy] I, Chen Ji, never make a losing trade.

text.content:
That dark eye narrowed slightly, as if examining Chen Ji.

After a moment, it spoke:

"Such boldness... truly one who can make the Tianji Record choose its master."

"Who am I... that question, you will naturally know when you've gathered all nine pages."

"As for why I'm imprisoned..." a complex emotion flickered in that eye, "Because I know too much."

"The cost of this fourth page... you only need to answer me one question: Do you want to know where your sister is?"

dialogue.content:
[Pupils contract sharply, voice suddenly ice-cold] You know Chen Nian's whereabouts?

[Suppresses surging emotions, voice cold] Speak.

[Inner thought: How much does this existence actually know? Is it testing me, or does it truly have intelligence? Either way... I cannot let it see how much Chen Nian means to me.]

text.content:
That dark eye emitted a low, rumbling laughter.

"Chen Nian... Heavenly Fate Lock Key... The most precious experimental subject of the Holy Sect..."

"She is beneath the abyss of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, where the continent's most ancient secrets are sealed."

"And the key to unsealing that seal..." that eye stared directly at Chen Ji, "lies within the Tianji Record in your hands."

As the words fell, that blood-stained page reappeared upon the pale hand.

"Accept it, and you will find her faster."

"Reject it..." that eye's smile deepened, "how long can your sister endure in that abyss? Three years? Five years? Or... might she be sacrificed by the Holy Sect in the very next moment?"

dialogue.content:
[Clenches fists, knuckles white, killing intent nearly erupting]

[Forces it down, voice cold] You're threatening me?

[Takes a deep breath] ...Fine. This page, I'll accept. But I warn you—

[Grabs the blood-stained page] If Chen Nian suffers so much as a scratch, whether you're deity or demon, I will drag you from that rift and tear you to shreds.

text.content:
That dark eye seemed utterly unconcerned by his threat, instead letting out a hearty laugh.

"Good! Good! Good!"

"This is the holder the Tianji Record should have—someone with weaknesses, with bonds, yet unyielding pride even unto death!"

That laughter gradually faded, and the rift began to rapidly close.

"Chen Ji, we shall meet again... when you've gathered all nine pages, that will be the day of our true meeting..."

"Before then... live well, don't disappoint me..."

The rift sealed completely, and that dark eye vanished into the darkness.

Only Chen Ji remained, the blood-stained page in his hand, and rage and doubt churning in his heart.

choices.memory_label: 陈念的位置：魔道圣宗深渊之下

text.content:
The moment the rift sealed, the battle at the east city gate reached its climax.

Without that oppressive pressure from the rift's depths, Chen Ji's divine sense instantly covered the entire battlefield. He saw the Tianqing Sect's defensive line collapsing, disciples retreating while fighting, with heavy casualties.

And Han Lie—that fool had actually broken free during his moment of distraction, now leading Xuanwu Sect disciples in a desperate final charge.

"Chen Ji!" Han Lie's roar thundered like celestial ice, "Today's humiliation, I Han Lie will avenge! Wait for me!"

Chen Ji gazed at that fleeing figure, a cold, mocking smile curling his lips.

Running?

He never said he'd let him go.

dialogue.content:
[Body blurs, vanishing from sight] Running? You think you can escape?

[The next instant appears before Han Lie, sword horizontal] Han Lie, did I give you permission to leave?

[Sword tip pressed to his throat, killing intent fierce] Earlier I said, before all under heaven, I would trample this "genius" beneath my feet.

[Sword light surges] You think I was joking?

text.content:
Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, face full of terror.

He wanted to retreat, but that jet-black sword had already locked his qi circulation, rendering him immobile.

"Chen... Chen Ji..." his voice began to tremble, "You can't kill me! My father is the Xuanwu Sect Master! If you kill me, the Xuanwu Sect will pursue you to the death!"

Chen Ji heard this, his smile turning even colder.

"To the death?"

He looked down at Han Lie, eyes full of contempt.

"Han Lie, what do you think you are? Worth the Xuanwu Sect clashing with me unto death?"

[Sword slightly twists, carving a blood gash across Han Lie's cheek]

"Today I won't kill you. I'll only cripple three-tenths of your power, leaving you alive to deliver a message."

"No—!" Han Lie let out a piercing scream. Chen Ji's long sword pierced his dantian, and a domineering force of Heavenly Secrets rushed in, shattering all three of his primary meridians. The excruciating pain nearly made Han Lie faint. He stared with wide eyes, disbelief written all over his face: "You... how dare you... my meridians..." Chen Ji pulled out his long sword, gazing calmly at Han Lie rolling and wailing on the ground. "Your meridians?" His voice was as placid as still water. "From now on, you will fall from genius to waste. How does that feel?" [Turning to face the Xuanwu Sect army, he shouted] "Han Lie's meridians have been destroyed by me! If any of you wish to live, retreat immediately—otherwise—" His voice turned icy cold. "Today, beneath the royal city, shall be your burial ground!"

The Xuanwu Sect army descended into chaos. Their commander, the first genius Han Lie, now lay in a pool of blood, his meridians shattered, his life uncertain. "Retreat! Quick, retreat!" "Senior Brother is finished!" "Run! If we don't leave now, we'll all die!" Panic spread like a plague. The thousands of Xuanwu Sect disciples instantly collapsed into disarray, scrambling to flee. Banners fell, equipment was abandoned, leaving behind a scene of utter devastation. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back atop the city wall, his robes fluttering violently in the cold wind, overlooking this rout. There was not a trace of triumph on his face. Because his gaze had fallen upon the magnificent palace deep within the royal city. There, a pair of golden vertical pupils was watching him. Those were the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate. And their master, the ailing Crown Prince Zhao Heng, stood at the highest point of the palace, gazing at him from afar.

dialogue.content: [Gazing into those golden vertical pupils, a meaningful curve appeared at the corner of his lips] [Murmuring in his heart: Zhao Heng... no, rather, the existence behind the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate... you thought I didn't know you were watching?] [Turning to glide down from the city wall, his voice cold] Today's matter ends here. [To himself] Though... this is only the beginning. The rifts, the Holy Sect, the Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets... and the secrets behind those obsidian eyes... [Gripping the blood-stained pages tightly in his hand] Wait and see. Whatever schemes you harbor, I, Chen Ji, will make you understand— [Gazing at the horizon, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes] This world has never been ruled by your dictates.

text.content: The chaos of the royal city thus temporarily subsided. The Xuanwu Sect fled in defeat, Han Lie was crippled, and the temporal-spatial rift closed for now. Though the Tianqing Sect suffered not insignificant losses, they had managed to defend the royal city. Yet everyone knew—this was merely the calm before the storm. Although the temporal-spatial rift had closed, that lingering gaze from those obsidian eyes still chilled the heart. The appearance of the Eyes of Heavenly Mandate's mark in Crown Prince Zhao Heng's eyes foretold that an even more terrifying conspiracy was brewing. And what vicissitudes would the fourth page fragment of the Tianji Record, which Chen Ji had obtained, bring to this chess game? Chen Ji stood on the highest tower of the royal city, gazing at the distant horizon. The night curtain gradually lifted, and a pale white glow spread across the eastern sky. A new day was about to begin. And his chess game would enter an entirely new phase. The fourth page of the Tianji Record—Observing Heaven. When he could peer into Heavenly Secrets, that would be the day the truth of this chess game was revealed. But before that... He lowered his gaze to the blood-stained pages in his hand, a hint of tenderness and guilt flickering in his eyes. Chen Nian, wait for me. Brother will definitely come to save you. He must.
